preconditions.description: The number of skewers n must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n and all(1 <= pi <= n for pi in p)
preconditions.description: The permutation p must have n elements, each between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: len(b) == n and all(bi in {0, 1} for bi in b)
preconditions.description: The sequence b must have n elements, each being either 0 or 1.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum total number of changes needed in p and b.
